The **Gauss Pistol** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Similar to the Gauss Rifle, the Gauss Pistol can be charged to increase the damage of the cartridge fired. The weapon cannot be traded, dropped, or sold to vendors.

Joon Choi created the concepts for the weapon and its modifications. [Doc 1] [Doc 2] The modification variants included an accelerator barrel, super charger barrel, and a shielded barrel, with the Gauss pistol from *Fallout 2* depicted alongside the designs in the concept art. [Doc 3] The notes describe the drum magazine design, spinning while ejecting 2mm electromagnetic cartridge rounds, with a red dot indicating when it was full and when it needed reloading. [Doc 4]
